name: Negative — Workflow Fails to Trigger
goal: Bot does not display any confirmation if the triggerMail workflow fails (no 'success' in response).
constraints: Employee details are valid. User selects 'hropsempletter'. Workflow triggerMail fails (e.g., returns error or no 'success').

phases.description: Bot fetches and displays employee details.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays employee details and presents options.
Bot triggers mail workflow silently. If workflow response does not contain 'success', bot does not display the confirmation message.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
